result.title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
result.summary: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 SPEED+ 航天器位姿估计上考察 conformal prediction 在 sim-to-real 分布偏移下的失效，观察到合成图校准得到的位姿集合在真实图像上失去覆盖率保证且大量失败是「静默」的，并提出先用外观转换（保持几何）后的合成图做校准，从而在无需真实标注的前提下恢复覆盖率、显著降低静默失败比例。
AI.relevance_reason: 视觉估计在分布偏移下的覆盖率保证与「静默失败」判定，可能为 LVR 中依据视觉证据决定何时信任状态或停止推理（STOP）提供评价与校准思路，但该工作面向位姿回归、不涉及 latent 推理，迁移可行性需较多核查。
